rule: Every tool family is judged once: WORKFLOW (staged orchestration with a declared evidence root and resume path), STEP (invoked by a WORKFLOW, no standalone side effects), STANDALONE (single-purpose tool), or LIBRARY (imported, no entrypoint). New scripts must be judged before they are used: a *_workflow.py entrypoint that is not triaged WORKFLOW fails the gate. Non-UNASSESSED families without a row fail; UNASSESSED legacy families warn until qualified.
